sites.name: Starbase
sites.detail: Orbital launch site, from the 2023 USGS Lower Rio Grande lidar. NAVD88 heights; inputOffset adds the GEOID18 geoid height at the site, giving heights above the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid, taken as WGS84.
sites.credit: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program, 2023 Lower Rio Grande lidar, public domain
